limitations.note: The patch only changed the triangle logic, leaving both square-wave comparisons at 20 and retaining a 21-clock period instead of the intended 20-clock period.

The triangle rewrite changed the first output after reset from 31 to 1 and changed how the triangle resumes from some intermediate values, whereas the reference only changes the upper direction threshold.
The testbench treated the buggy 21-clock square-wave period as correct and validated the rewritten triangle startup rather than checking the behavior the reference preserves.
